answer: Identity is proven in a night vault, not a pre-cut list. The applicant bonds 12.4 POA and records a lid commitment before lot 27 drops a 9-byte walnut tick. Within 110 seconds, two established non-kin inspectors, each allowed two lots this epoch, braid the tick, the lid, and their heights into one thread receipt. Explorers check that the lid predates the tick, both marks exist, and the cap holds. A 9,200-key farm needs 114,080 POA plus 18,400 exclusive inspector slots. A late braid, a lid written after the tick, or a kin pair burns 63% of the bond and benches those inspectors for six epochs.
